newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sakakibara to become vice finance minister July 15.
newsitem.headline: Sakakibara to become vice finance minister July 15.

text.p: Ministry of Finance (MOF) official Eisuke Sakakibara is to be appointed vice minister for international affairs, a senior ministry official told reporters on Friday.
His appointment will become official on July 15 following cabinet approval, the official said.
Sakakibara, currently director-general of the ministry's International Finance Bureau, has been dubbed "Mr Yen" by the media for his influence over currency markets.
The present vice finance minister for international affairs, Takatoshi Kato, will retire, the officical said.
Haruhiko Kuroda, currently president of the ministry's Institute of Fiscal and Monetary Policy, will succeed Sakakibara at the International Finance Bureau.
Takeshi Komura, currently director-general of the ministry's Budget Bureau, will succeed Tadashi Ogawa as vice finance minister, the top bureaucratic post in the ministry.
Komura's post will be filled by Yoji Wakui, presently the deputy vice minister at the Secretariat.
Four directors-general in charge of departments closely associated with financial markets will remain in their posts to carry on with the "Big Bang" financial reforms, he said.
